fences.title: Bunny is the healthy-path portrait accelerator
fences.decision: Bunny accelerates public immutable portrait and card bytes on healthy networks. First-party identity remains canonical, and a failed accelerator affects only the requesting context.
fences.reason: Healthy readers should not spend the shared Worker allowance on image bytes, while one provider or region must not become a second canon.
fences.change_control: A replacement must preserve byte identity, bounded fallback, regional independence, and equal or lower shared-budget use. Implementation details may change without preserving the old mechanism.

fences.title: Gene discovery is eligibility-gated and range-stable
fences.decision: One published card defines each gene's public identity and canonical blot. Complete profiles are discoverable; incomplete or inconsistent publication fails closed and never repairs itself on a reader request.
fences.reason: Search, archives, metadata, and images must agree without making public readers perform authoring work.
fences.change_control: A replacement must keep one eligibility rule and one public image identity across every surface. Rendering, indexing, storage, and sitemap mechanics may change.

fences.title: Queue wakeups follow durable due times
fences.decision: Automatic messages wake durable due work; they are not polling tokens. Repeated dirty work is coalesced, and every mutation is admitted before it spends shared capacity.
fences.reason: Blind retries and one-message-per-event designs can exhaust queues and databases without producing user value.
fences.change_control: A replacement must preserve durable intent, idempotency, bounded idle cost, and fail-closed admission. Queue topology, batch sizes, lanes, and schedules may change.

fences.title: The primary Iconoplasm D1 is bounded operational state
fences.decision: The primary Iconoplasm D1 stores bounded operational state. Large immutable bodies and retained history use appropriate separate storage and explicit retention.
fences.reason: Unbounded history or duplicated payloads can fill the mutation database and stop unrelated user actions.
fences.change_control: A replacement must prove bounded growth, recoverability, and truthful capacity reporting. Tables, thresholds, retention periods, and storage layout may change.

fences.title: Fulfillment is one bounded receipt per completed publication, recipient, and gene
fences.decision: One completed publication has one durable fulfillment identity per recipient and gene. Notifications and inbox state derive from that receipt.
fences.reason: Timing and row adjacency cannot reliably identify a complete human-visible result.
fences.change_control: A replacement must preserve group completeness, idempotency, bounded payloads, and one acknowledgement boundary. Presentation and delivery mechanisms may change.

fences.title: Iconoplasm is static-first with one dynamic Worker invocation
fences.decision: Anonymous Iconoplasm reading is static or CDN-first. Dynamic Workers serve explicit private actions, mutations, and administration rather than ordinary public content.
fences.reason: Public reading must scale without consuming a metered stateful invocation for every asset or page.
fences.change_control: A replacement must demonstrate equal or lower Worker use and preserve complete public reading. Routing, caching, and deployment mechanics may change.

fences.title: Anonymous startup and extension hover use the published read plane
fences.decision: Anonymous startup and extension hover use immutable published data and bounded local reuse. They do not probe private identity, scan mutable state, or repair publication.
fences.reason: Reading should remain fast and available without coupling every page or hover to authentication and database capacity.
fences.change_control: A replacement must preserve one published authority, independent portrait and detail progress, bounded caches, and zero mutable-state fallback for anonymous reads. Client scheduling and transport may change.

fences.title: Iconoplasm public reads stay cold-safe inside the one loud state boundary
fences.decision: Anonymous gene documents resolve one publisher's coherent static release. They never reconstruct public truth from D1, Durable Objects, Queues, sessions, or a second state owner.
fences.reason: A static published read plane keeps failures and traffic away from the mutation authority.
fences.change_control: A replacement must preserve one publisher, coherent fallback, and separation between public reads and mutable state. File names, manifests, object layout, and service topology may change.

fences.title: Routine gallery publication is dirty-shard-only
fences.decision: Routine publication processes changed content only and advances one coherent release. It never falls back to rebuilding the corpus.
fences.reason: Small user changes must not trigger work proportional to every published gene.
fences.change_control: A replacement must prove work is bounded by changed content and remains resumable and atomic. Shard layout, step size, and schedule may change.

fences.title: Every public canonical blot uses one published card artifact
fences.decision: The committed published card owns the public character, selected source portrait, and canonical blot for a gene. Every public surface resolves that same identity.
fences.reason: Separate portrait, metadata, and page authorities create split canon that readers cannot reason about.
fences.change_control: A replacement must preserve one committed identity, immutable verified bytes, and agreement across site, extension, APIs, metadata, and media. Storage and publication formats may change.

fences.title: Caretaker manifestation history has one encrypted Website authority

operation_cost_migration.contract: Register an immutable prediction before dispatch; reserve each verified step against both twice the prediction and shared daily headroom. The authority dispatches D1 and settles provider receipts. Unknown outcomes remain charged. Direct API, CI and legacy binding cutover must be complete before claiming mandatory enforcement. No new Worker, DO namespace, or reader coordination hop.

fences.decision: The Website is the sole command authority for caretaker and manifestation state. Sensitive bodies remain private and encrypted; the workstation is a version-bound replica and executor.
fences.reason: Multiple writers or plaintext replicas create conflicting authorship, lost updates, and privacy failures.
fences.change_control: A replacement must preserve one writer, immutable revision identity, encryption, idempotency, and rebuildable replication. Database schema, transport, quotas, and storage layout may change.

fences.title: Daily targets give every gene surname one slot
fences.decision: Automatic GeneGuessr selection gives each normalized gene surname one slot in a deterministic without-replacement cycle.
fences.reason: Rows and aliases must not multiply a family's lottery weight.
fences.change_control: A replacement must preserve one slot per surname and deterministic replay. Pool storage and selection implementation may change.

fences.title: Recap images require pixel and storage proof
fences.decision: A GeneGuessr recap image is publishable only after visible molecule pixels are ready and storage returns the exact uploaded bytes.
fences.reason: A successful request or attachment placeholder does not prove a usable recap image exists.
fences.change_control: A replacement must preserve pixel readiness, immutable identity, exact read-back, resumability, and text-only fallback. Renderer and storage mechanics may change.

fences.title: Remote prose checks are explicit, snapshot-bound, and free-Zen-only
fences.decision: Remote prose checking runs only after an explicit command against one immutable complete-document snapshot, using the approved free provider path.
fences.reason: Background remote traffic and mutable partial input violate privacy, cost, and review integrity.
fences.change_control: A replacement must preserve explicit initiation, snapshot identity, narrow credentials, and fail-closed cost behavior. Provider and implementation may change with owner approval.
